words.word: then should i yet have comfort

occurrences.text: Then should I yet have comfort; yea, I would harden myself in sorrow: let him not spare; for I have not concealed the words of the Holy One.
words: Then should I yet have comfort

occurrences.text: This is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.
